the final surprise

Happy Birthday,
mera bacha ❤️

My Bubuu, today is all about you, and I hope you know how deeply special you are to me. You have this beautiful way of making ordinary moments feel warmer, happier, and worth remembering. Your smile can change my whole mood, your little habits make me smile when I least expect it, and simply having you around makes life feel a little more complete. I don't know what every tomorrow will look like, but I know I want more memories with you, more random laughs, more late conversations, more silly moments, and more days where we look back and say, “remember this?” On your birthday, I wish you peace when life feels heavy, confidence when you doubt yourself, and endless reasons to smile. Please keep being the beautiful, crazy, adorable Bubuu that you are. Thank you for being you, for becoming such a precious part of my life, and for giving me so many moments I never want to forget. Happy Birthday, mera bacha. I love you. ❤️
